newsitem.title: USA: Montgomery hires for high-yield sales, research.
newsitem.headline: Montgomery hires for high-yield sales, research.

text.p: Montgomery Securities on Tuesday said it hired John Crotty from Credit Suisse First Boston and Steve Chronert from NationsBank Corp as principals in its high-yield sales department.
In addition, Montgomery said it hired Rosemary Sisson as a principal in the high-yield research group, specializing in retail and consumer product research.
Sisson most recently worked at CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp, a unit of Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce.
Crotty and Chronert were director and managing director, respectively, in their previous employment.
